key_principles: Clarity over Decoration: Content is dense (questions, formulas), so UI must be invisible.
Soft Guidance: Use pastel colors to categorize, not to shout.
Generous Whitespace: Reduce cognitive load for stressed students.
Rounded & Friendly: Avoid sharp corporate edges. Make it feel approachable.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');

layout_strategy.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 hidden md:block border-r bg-[#E9ECEF]/50

rules: Ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1 against pastel backgrounds.
Never rely on color alone for status (use icons + text).
Focus states must be visible (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-blue-500).
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

do_not: Center text in cards unless it's a specific callout.
Use heavy drop shadows (use soft, large blurs instead).
Clutter the interface with too many borders.
do: Use Skeleton loaders for all async data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom pastel colors defined in 'colors.palette'.
Use 'Layout.jsx' or similar wrapper to enforce the sidebar structure.
Ensure 'Plus Jakarta Sans' is loaded and used for headings.
Mock all API calls if backend is not ready, but structure data realistically.
Implement 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, inputs, and links.
